FQHECylinderQuasiholesWithSpinTimeReversalSymmetryGenerateBasis, version 0.01

Usage: FQHECylinderQuasiholesWithSpinTimeReversalSymmetryGenerateBasis [options]

    --optimize-chargingenergy : find the optimal value of the charging energy such that it is minimal at the indicated number of particles (only valid if positive) (default value = -1)
    --only-optimize : only compute the optimal value of the charging energy without generating the effective basis
    --fix-nbrparticles : fix the number of particles for the two layer system (no restriction if negative) (default value = -1)
    --degeneracy-error : difference below which two energies are considered to be degenerate (default value = 9.9999999999999998e-13)
    --directory : use a specific directory for the input data instead of the current one (only useful when building the eigenstates in the full quasihole basis)

ouput options:
    --build-eigenstates : build the eigenstates in the full quasihole basis
    --write-eigenstatebasis : write a file that describes the effective eigenstate basis
    --build-effectivehamiltonian : compute and store all the  building blocks to generate the Hamiltonian in the effective basis
    --write-fullspectrum : write the full spectrum of the two decoupled layer problem (including the charging energy)
